subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: When an existing workspace ignore file exceeds the safe read limit, should the affected scan stop or skip that directory subtree?
rationale: Both choices preserve the memory bound without silently losing exclusions, but selecting the permanent cross-caller failure behavior requires owner intent.

options.title: Stop affected scan
options.body: Return an actionable error and require the user to reduce or replace the oversized ignore file before scanning continues.

options.title: Skip affected subtree
options.body: Continue unrelated roots but refuse traversal below the directory whose ignore policy could not be loaded.

options.title: Continue without rules
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior and explicitly accept broader traversal for oversized ignore files.

recommendation.title: Stop affected scan
recommendation.body: Return an actionable error and require the user to reduce or replace the oversized ignore file before scanning continues.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance most strongly connects this person to the shared helper and both recursive caller families.
